marks.gloss_en: found letters of assessment or maintenance, documents of chalitza or refusal, or pleading documents -- these are returned
mishna (20a): any court enactment that is found is returned -- Rabba's ground for returning the court gett
a note found among one's own notes, its nature unknown, lies impounded until Eliyahu comes
here (in Bavel) they explained shtarei berurin as pleading documents -- the recorded claims of the parties
